# That's How I Turbined My IA's

The video summarizes Gio Mangoni's tips to configure AI tools beyond the text box: personal instructions, memory, connectors with other applications and isolated projects. It shows that the same logic applies to Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude and Qwen, and ends with a practical challenge.

Video by Maurício Yokoyama Issei, published on September 25, 2026 (7 min 9 s).
Watch: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nBqzt727GJ4

_The video and the transcript are in Portuguese. The minutes between brackets, such as [04:12], point to the excerpt of the video._

## The settings that hardly anyone uses

Many people use AI tools every day without knowing that there is a layer of settings behind [00:00]. The difference appears in the Gemini example: without configuration, it does not know who you are; configured, responds already knowing your context [00:20].

The video summarizes Gio Mangoni's tips, which, according to the video, created the method after 250 consulting in AI [00:41]. She realized that most professionals do not know that it is possible to configure the AI at this level [01:04].

## Hidden prompts

The AI not only reads what you type, but also a series of invisible prompts [01:45]. The video compares to a restaurant: what you type is the request to the waiter; hidden prompts are the rules of the kitchen [01:45].

## Personal instructions and memory

The first step is to configure personal instructions: your context, for example AI consultant, and rules such as "advanced level, no emojis" [02:05]. So you don't have to repeat that to every conversation [02:26].

Memory keeps the context over time and improves the next responses [02:48]. But she needs care [02:48]:

- activate or disable memory resources [03:09];
- update the facts saved, for example when an old strategy ceases to be valid [03:09];
- Delete old conversations because old data generate bad answers with a lot of confidence [03:09].

## Connectors with other applications

The connectors pull the AI out of the bubble. In Gemini, you can connect Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive and Calendar) and YouTube [03:29]. On other platforms, you can connect Notion, Slack, Canva and HubSpot [03:51].

With this, you consult live data. For example: "Resume last month's services from my calendar" instead of opening five tabs and copying and pasting [03:51].

## Isolated projects

Projects, also called notebooks, are isolated environments for specific tasks, such as a budget assistant with its own financial rules [04:31]. As they are isolated, the AI does not mix the rules of a cost spreadsheet with a brainstorming from another chat [04:53].

To build a project [04:53]:

- define the name and description [04:53];
- write the instructions of that environment [04:53];
- consolidate a chat history [04:53];
- send context files or links, such as a brand manual or transcript of a meeting [05:14].

The logic applies to various tools: Gemini speaks in notebooks and extensions; ChatGPT, Claude and Qwen speak in projects, connectors or plugins [05:36].

## The Challenge

The challenge is to send the transcript that gave rise to the video for a new project and ask the AI for use cases and instructions for a real workflow [05:56]. To view each menu on screen, the video recommends the original channel of Gio Mangoni on YouTube [06:16].

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Why delete old conversations?

Because AI uses memory to respond, and outdated data generates bad answers with a lot of confidence [03:09].

### Does this work on any AI tool?

Logic works on Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude and Qwen. Change only the name of the menu [05:36].

## About the video

Do you want much more relevant and personalized answers from your artificial intelligence tools? In this video, you will learn to configure the calls **hidden prompts**, simple and powerful features present on major market platforms to turn AI into a highly contextualized assistant.

Learn to apply **permanent instructions**, manage the **AI memory**, activate **Application connectors** and structure **dedicated projects and folders** to never need to reexplain your work context from scratch.

---

📌 **What you will learn in this video:**
* **Permanent Instructions and Customization:** How to inform your professional context and define exactly the response style you prefer.
* **Memory Management:** Understand how AI saves facts about you over time and how to view, edit or clear that memory.
* **Connectors with Applications:** Connect your AI to Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Drive, Calendar), Slack, Canva and other tools for direct queries and automations.
* **Organizational Projects and Environments:** Create folders/notebooks with documents and guidelines specific to specific projects.
* **Multiple Demonstration Tools:** Practical guide **Gemini**, **ChatGPT**, **Claude**, **Qwen**, **Perplexity**, **Manus** and **Grok**.
